decisions.statement: A member's globals are named by the member's own `addon.json`.
A member naming no global is skipped.
A migration already done leaves a marker naming the globals written.
A marker present at all means the migration is done.
The marker has the digest of the bundle file read from.
Nothing here removes the member's globals from the bundle file.
Nothing here says what a migration did.

definition: one addon's saved variables lifted back out of the bundle file with them
